notes: The BS in Computer Science has three options (Algorithm Design, Data Science, Software Engineering) with a shared core (CSCI 150, 151, 232, 258, 315E, 332, 340). All Montana syllabi found are in UM ScholarWorks, whose PDFs were blocked by a bot challenge during this run, so every course is marked not-found although public syllabi exist; this is a retrieval failure, not evidence of absence.
